title: Easy Chicken and Gnocchi Soup
description: This quick recipe for chicken and gnocchi soup is perfect for those chilly fall and winter nights, and is easy enough to make on a weeknight.
ingredients: salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
0.5 cup grated Parmesan cheese, or to taste

steps.text: Combine chicken broth, garlic, butter, and sugar in a large saucepan; bring to a simmer and cook until garlic is tender, about 2 minutes. Stir carrot and celery into simmering broth; cook until vegetables are almost tender, about 2 minutes more.

Bring broth mixture to a boil and stir gnocchi into the saucepan; cook until gnocchi rise to the top and are tender yet firm to the bite, 2 to 3 minutes. Add peas and corn to broth mixture; simmer until heated through, about 30 seconds.
Stir chicken and spinach into broth mixture; remove from heat and season soup with salt and black pepper. Ladle soup into bowls and top with Parmesan cheese.
